name: RWKV-7
summary: The published RWKV-7 MiniPile path ran for two optimizer steps on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell without changing upstream model or kernel source. MiniPile opened at 1,498,226,207 tokens, the sm_120 CUDA kernels compiled, training produced losses, and the run published a 382 MB checkpoint plus its training log. The strict record gate is CLEAN 14/14 with an AI-BOM score of 100 and a portable freeze. Independent cold certification remains pending. A separate L40S attempt still records a hardware-specific upstream finding: the current channel-mix kernel does not compile for sm_89.
truncationNote: The capture used the upstream model, dataset and optimizer settings but stopped after two optimizer steps with --max_steps=2. Removing that limit restores the published 72 epochs (181,440 optimizer steps at 2,520 steps per epoch).

truncation.note: The capture stopped after two optimizer steps. The published 72 epochs at 2,520 optimizer steps per epoch total 181,440 steps.

fullRun.estimateBasis: 181,440 published optimizer steps divided by the measured steady 10.60 steps/s, plus about eight minutes of setup, data access, compilation and publication. Only two optimizer steps were measured, so this is an order-of-magnitude estimate rather than a benchmark.

issues.title: The current CUDA channel-mix kernel does not compile for sm_89
issues.detail: The published one-GPU MiniPile path imports rwkv7_cmix_bf16_v5 during initialization. On an NVIDIA L40S, nvcc targets sm_89 and rejects its float2 atomicAdd. The same unpatched source compiled and trained on sm_120.
issues.fix: provide an sm_89-compatible accumulation implementation, such as architecture-gated scalar float atomics

experimentUrlNote: Upstream WandB logging initialized through the hosted bridge. The remote project database contains the exact run id 08c22e97f6e74f97be05a0d063a9739e and its step-2 loss, learning rate, weight decay, token count and throughput metrics; this was verified from the stored data, not from an HTTP status.
